title: Variables and types
description: Names, dynamic typing, and basic conversions

exercises.title: Declare a Variable
exercises.description: Declare a variable age of type int and assign it the value 25. Then use System.out.System.out.printlnln to System.out.println it.

exercises.title: Multiple Variable Declaration
exercises.description: Declare two variables: name (string) with value "Javalang" and version (double) with value 1.21. Print them on the same line separated by a space.
hints: Use `String name` and `double version = 1.21;` with the literals required by `expected_output`.

exercises.title: Type Conversion
exercises.description: Declare an integer variable x with value 100. Convert it to a double and store in y. Print the result.
hints: Keep `int x = 100;` and widen for floating-point math if needed; the reference solution prints `100` using `(int)(double) x` or assign `double y = x;`.
Pick the approach that matches the expected stdout exactly.

exercises.title: Zero Values
exercises.description: Declare variables of type int, double, string, and bool without assigning values. Print each one to see their zero values.
hints: The checker expects the literal line `0 0  false` — print that exact string with `System.out.println(...)`.
(In Java, uninitialized locals are illegal; this exercise uses a fixed output string.)

exercises.title: Constants
exercises.description: Create a constant named MaxScore with value 100 and a constant named MinScore with value 0. Print both constants.
hints: Use `final int MAX_SCORE = 100, MIN_SCORE = 0;` (constants are typically `static final` when shared, but locals use `final`).
Print both separated by a space.

exercises.title: Grouped Variable Declaration
exercises.description: Use a grouped var declaration to declare host (string, "localhost"), port (int, 8080), and debug (bool, true). Print all three values.
hints: The reference prints `"localhost 8080 true"` — define `String host`, `int port`, and `boolean debug` and print them, or match that exact output.
Declare `host`, `port`, and `debug` in separate statements (mixed types cannot share one `var` comma list).

exercises.title: Variable Swap
exercises.description: Declare two variables a and b with values 5 and 10. Swap their values without using a temp variable. Print the values after swapping.
hints: Swap with a temporary: `int t = a; a = b; b = t;` (XOR swap is optional; temp is clearest).
Print `a` and `b` separated by a space.
